+++ b/src/click/named_range_variable.py
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .types import _NumberRangeBase
+
+
+class NamedRangeVariable(_NumberRangeBase):
+    """A :class:`_NumberRangeBase` that names the variable ``value``
+    instead of ``x`` when describing the range.
+    """
+
+    def _describe_range(self) -> str:
+        """Describe the range for use in help text."""
+        if self.min is None:
+            op = "<" if self.max_open else "<="
+            return f"value{op}{self.max}"
+
+        if self.max is None:
+            op = ">" if self.min_open else ">="
+            return f"value{op}{self.min}"
+
+        lop = "<" if self.min_open else "<="
+        rop = "<" if self.max_open else "<="
+        return f"{self.min}{lop}value{rop}{self.max}"
notes:
Added src/click/named_range_variable.py with NamedRangeVariable(_NumberRangeBase), overriding _describe_range with the same logic and signature as the base but using "value" instead of "x"; base has no super() calls or decorators to preserve, and no existing modules were edited.
